# ovirt_vnic_profile (Data Source)

The ovirt_vnic_profile data source returns the ID and details of a VNIC profile by its name, with optional filtering by network_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the VNIC profile.

### Optional

- `network_id` (String) ID of the logical network the VNIC profile belongs to. If multiple profiles have the same name, this disambiguates them.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the VNIC profile.
